metadata.provenanceNote: Rolling seven-day publication assembled from approved official cinema sources.

films.descriptionZh: 上世纪六十年代的小说家周在写作与情感之间游走，借虚构与现实交织出丰腴的忧郁。
films.descriptionEn: A sort-of sequel revisiting Chow as a suave science-fiction writer in 1960s settings, intercutting his affairs with scenes from his novel set in the year 2046 to craft a film of voluptuous melancholy and memory.

films.descriptionZh: 一名黑帮执行者因心软而陷入生死追逐，行动与情感紧绷交织。
films.descriptionEn: A tightly wound neo-noir about a mob enforcer whose decision to spare his boss’s mistress propels him into a desperate fight for survival, blending emotional stakes with stylized, dangerous action and a distinctive musical palette.

films.descriptionZh: 杨氏青春记忆中六〇年代台湾的黑帮、政治压抑与美国流行文化的交织图景。
一名流浪者被发掘成媒体巨星，权力腐蚀其人。
films.descriptionEn: An Arkansas drifter is discovered by a small‑station producer and becomes an overnight media sensation, rising to great fame and influence—and risking exposure as the fraud he has become.

films.descriptionZh: 被克隆回归的里普利在太空船上与新一代异形相遇，血缘与敌意交织。

films.canonicalTitle: All the Mornings of the World + Live Performance | Instruments of Desire
films.displayTitle: All the Mornings of the World + Live Performance | Instruments of Desire
films.descriptionZh: 一位隐居大师与弟子之间的音乐与记忆交织，成就深沉的艺术冥想。
films.descriptionEn: A reclusive master and his ambitious pupil become entwined in a haunting portrait of artistic devotion, memory, and longing, set against a landmark viola da gamba score and inspired by a novelist’s meditation on music and creativity.

films.descriptionZh: 科学家以隔离与迷幻药探索意识边界与现实本质。
films.descriptionEn: A research scientist experiments with sensory deprivation and hallucinogenic mixtures drawn from Native American shamanic practice to push the boundaries of human consciousness, uncovering shifts in memory, time, and reality itself.

films.descriptionZh: 八十年代的纽约与唐人街中，两个意外结伴的人物展开温馨而略带喜感的情感故事。

films.canonicalTitle: André Leon Talley: Style is Forever
films.displayTitle: André Leon Talley: Style is Forever
films.descriptionZh: 纪实讲述塔利的时尚影响力、包容与真实追求。
films.descriptionEn: A documentary portrait of André Leon Talley that traces his decades-long influence on fashion, highlighting his commitment to inclusivity, elegance, and an uncompromising pursuit of authenticity through interviews and rare footage.

films.descriptionZh: 布莱希特改编的古希腊悲剧，抗争与定罪并置。
films.descriptionEn: Brecht’s adaptation of Sophocles’ Antigone staged amid ancient ruins, portraying the title character’s rebellion against King Creon’s death sentence and presenting the tragedy in its entirety within an antiquarian setting.

films.descriptionZh: 基辅兵工厂工人起义及其残酷镇压，交织革命与乡土情感的诗性影像。
用象征身体与神祇的三位主角展开一场原始而抽象的仪式影像。
films.descriptionEn: An abstract, ritualistic film that names its principal figures as God Killing Himself, Mother Earth, and Son of Earth — a cinematic exploration of what those personae do to and with one another.

films.canonicalTitle: Bread Day preceded by The Train Stop
films.displayTitle: Bread Day preceded by The Train Stop
films.descriptionZh: 偏远村落老人推着货车取面包，这一周例行仪式既顽强又寓含制度隐喻。
一场车站偶遇引发的短暂离别与深切哀愁。
films.descriptionEn: A simple, tender drama of a furtive affair between two married people whose chance meetings at a railway station grow into mutual love and mounting agony across seven meetings, propelled by evocative dialogue and a haunting musical theme.

films.descriptionZh: 教授在古老档案中追踪疑似被梵蒂冈掩盖的时间观看装置，走入文字与阴谋的迷宫。
两个失恋警察、菠萝罐头与加州梦交织的香港情书。
films.descriptionEn: A pop-infused, bifurcated tale of two lovelorn cops and the women who baffle them, told in a sensorial, richly stylized mode that invites the viewer to sink into a world equal parts vivid, bittersweet, and heartbreakingly intimate.

films.canonicalTitle: Cinema Tehran presents: Marjane Satrapi’s Chicken with Plums
films.displayTitle: Cinema Tehran presents: Marjane Satrapi’s Chicken with Plums
films.descriptionZh: 德黑兰的音乐家爱琴折断后失去生意志，沉眠于记忆與夢境中追溯往昔與戀情。
films.descriptionEn: In Tehran, after his beloved violin is broken, renowned musician Nasser Ali Khan loses his will to live and, confined to bed, drifts through memories and dreams of his youth, family, and a great lost love that inspired his music.

films.descriptionZh: 时尚设计师白天体面，夜晚化身妓女China Blue，引来侦探与疯狂牧师的危险纠葛。
films.descriptionEn: Fashion designer Joanna Crane leads a double life as the prostitute China Blue, drawing the attention of a sexually frustrated private detective and becoming entangled with a psychopathic priest who possesses a murderous sex toy.

films.descriptionZh: 矿镇少男少女进城打拼，征召与分离考验他们的爱情。
乌克兰乡村与机械化的冲突，田园与土地的颂歌。
一位百岁女性登台试镜，独白中揭示公众视野下的奇异真相。
films.descriptionEn: An elderly woman in her centenarian years arrives to audition for a Broadway play and, standing alone on stage, reveals strange truths about a life lived in the public eye and the woman the world thought she knew.

films.descriptionZh: 两位导演携手呈现围绕一位囚犯与相关争议的纪实叙事。
films.descriptionEn: Acclaimed directors collaborate on a documentary that examines the contested story of Leonard Peltier, tracing the events and disputes surrounding his case through investigative storytelling.

films.canonicalTitle: Ghost in the Shell: 30th Anniversary Remaster
films.displayTitle: Ghost in the Shell: 30th Anniversary Remaster
films.descriptionZh: 2029年，半机械化的少校追踪一个在信息海洋中诞生的神秘存在。
films.descriptionEn: In 2029 a cyborg Major tracks an omnipotent entity born in a sea of information—an ambiguous hacker or virus threatening world order—while the animation blends hand-drawn and CGI techniques to render her physical and existential journey.

films.descriptionZh: 台北老戏院最后一场放映，各色观众与记忆交织。
拜伦与珀西、玛丽·雪莱及克莱尔在日内瓦湖畔借迷幻药编织恐怖故事，幻觉与现实交错。
films.descriptionEn: Set on an estate by Lake Geneva, Lord Byron hosts Percy and Mary Shelley and Claire Clairmont; aided by hallucinogens they invent a night of ghoulish tales that escalate until it’s impossible to tell apparition from reality.

films.descriptionZh: 讽刺又辛辣的校园黑色喜剧，毒舌与暗黑笑料交织。
films.descriptionEn: A cynical, surreal dark high‑school comedy that masks sharper themes beneath gleefully nasty putdowns and iconic performances; its bitter humor and memorable lines have made it one of the most influential teen films in modern times.

films.descriptionZh: 一名工业家在误以为儿子被绑後陷入绑架风暴，影片以精确构图与惊险场面探讨正义與阶级。
偏远村庄遭神秘怪物肆虐，猎人与警察陷入错综悲剧。
films.descriptionEn: In a remote South Korean village, police and a group of hunters pursue a mysterious creature that wreaks havoc; as perceptions mislead and human conflicts escalate, ignorance seeds disaster and tragedy swells to cosmic proportions.

films.descriptionZh: 一位白人寡妇与黑人单亲母亲结识，命运交织。
films.descriptionEn: In 1940s New York, a white widow who dreams of Broadway has a chance encounter with a black single mother who becomes her maid, and their lives become intertwined.

films.descriptionZh: 阿伽門農與王后被命令為遠征特洛伊犧牲女兒，古典悲劇在實景中呈現。
一位乡村侦探在纽约调查失踪案，牵出危险线索。
films.descriptionEn: A small‑town police detective comes to New York to investigate his friend’s disappearance; his only lead is a letter to Bree Daniels, and as attraction develops he realizes she may be the murderer’s real target.

films.descriptionZh: 李斯特试图戒除放纵，却屡被瓦格纳诱回。
films.descriptionEn: In a stylized take on the 19th century, composer-pianist Franz Liszt struggles to end his hedonistic ways but repeatedly finds himself drawn back by the seductive influence of fellow composer Richard Wagner.

films.descriptionZh: 1963年，一位离经的单亲母亲带着女儿迁居小镇，冲突与救赎并行。
在特拉维夫屋顶的秘密对话中，以色列人揭露加沙大屠杀的系统设计与运作。
films.descriptionEn: Through secret rooftop conversations in Tel Aviv, Israeli filmmakers and journalists reveal the systems behind the calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza, drawing on the testimony of those who designed and operated them.

films.descriptionZh: 女儿被招募为间谍赴潜伏纳粹之人身边，而她与招募者之间也逐渐情愫暗生，风险骤增。
films.descriptionEn: Recruited to help bring Nazis to justice, Alicia Huberman becomes an undercover operative who must seduce a Nazi in hiding; as she and her handler grow closer, her deepening cover creates ever higher stakes and danger.

films.descriptionZh: 大蕭條時期，越獄三人組沿密西西比展開荒誕尋愛旅程，途遇詩意與惡徒。
从神话出发，讲述无知的命运将一人推入与母亲的悲剧纠葛。
films.descriptionEn: A reworking of Sophocles’ tragedy that begins with a prologue in prewar Italy and follows Oedipus as an unwitting victim of his own ignorance, staged with color, stylized costumes, and an almost science-fiction vision of the ancient world.

films.descriptionZh: 一位朱利亚德中提琴手在纽约与往事纠缠，被一场意外机会和旧爱逼入抉择。

films.canonicalTitle: Once Upon a Time in China
films.displayTitle: Once Upon a Time in China
films.descriptionZh: 以黄飞鸿为中心的充满速度感的武侠史诗。

films.canonicalTitle: Once Upon a Time in China II
films.displayTitle: Once Upon a Time in China II
films.descriptionZh: 黄飞鸿再战，城中动荡與革命冲突并起。

films.canonicalTitle: Once Upon a Time in China III
films.displayTitle: Once Upon a Time in China III
films.descriptionZh: 黄飞鸿再赴京城，狮舞竞赛与暗杀阴谋交织。
梦境记录技术外泄，潜意识影像与现实交织威胁城市秩序。
films.descriptionEn: In a near future where therapists can record dreams with the DC Mini, the theft of a prototype causes subconscious images to bleed into reality, sparking a race to prevent a psychedelic dream apocalypse on the streets.

films.descriptionZh: 以1913年脆弱的民国为背景，三位倔强女性在戏曲、权力与情爱间交织冒险。
films.descriptionEn: Set in fragile Republican-era China, three irrepressible women—a would-be Peking Opera star, a warlord’s daughter, and a jewel-thief courtesan—collide in a fizzing mashup of espionage, screwball romance, slapstick, and costume spectacle.

films.descriptionZh: 一位肤色极浅的黑人女子隐瞒身世后面临跨种族婚姻与家庭的抉择。
在反乌托邦的底特律，义体警察穿梭于公司权力与犯罪之间。
在钢琴前的告别独奏，贯穿黄魔乐队到影像配乐的二十首生涯曲目。
纪录片跟随坂本龍一在确诊癌症后重返创作，将对死亡意识化为音乐。
films.descriptionEn: An intimate portrait that follows Ryuichi Sakamoto as he returns to composing after a cancer diagnosis, channeling a renewed awareness of mortality into his latest musical work.

films.descriptionZh: 两位侦探在一座潮湿破败的城市追踪手法极端的连环杀手。
films.descriptionEn: A nearing-retirement detective and his newcomer partner track a serial killer with theatrical methods through a perpetually sodden, decaying city, confronting gruesome crimes and moral collapse.

films.descriptionZh: 丧夫母亲迁居故乡后遭遇惨痛失子，信仰与绝望交锋。
围绕乌克兰红军指挥官什乔尔斯的传记片，糅合英雄颂与诗意画面。
films.descriptionEn: A biopic of the Bolshevik commander Mykola Shchors that combines vigorous, propagandistic hagiography with moments of ineffable poetry, reflecting Ukrainian cultural tradition amid the pressures of politically commissioned filmmaking.

films.descriptionZh: 在衰落的雅典，哲人挑衅与被沉默的命运交织。
films.descriptionEn: Rossellini’s portrait places Socrates in an Athens humbled by Sparta, where the philosopher’s probing provocations unsettle the city and ultimately lead to forces determined to silence him, rendered with austere, experimental filmmaking.

films.descriptionZh: 工人出身的斯特拉为女儿牺牲，最终选择放手。
films.descriptionEn: Working‑class Stella marries into wealth and, after their separation, centers her life on daughter Laurel—coming to realize that Laurel can flourish without her.

films.descriptionZh: 一位父亲在城市荒凉中为孩子勉强维生，超市里孩子们寻找保护。
films.descriptionEn: A minimalist portrait of urban desolation: a single father ekes out a subsistence living as a human signboard while his hungry children spend their days in a supermarket, where they encounter a protector in the store manager.

films.descriptionZh: 失業男子為籌腎臟移植經費捲入綁架計畫，絕望逐漸演變為暴力的連鎖反應。
围绕上流社会礼俗与禁忌的爱情与抉择，在晚清十九世纪纽约的社交圈中展开。
films.descriptionEn: An adaptation of Edith Wharton’s story that traces the strict social mores and hidden taboos of New York’s wealthy classes, following a lawyer torn between duty and a forbidden longing amid rigid expectations.

films.descriptionZh: 基层音乐剧的替角被迫上场，承担起演出重任。
films.descriptionEn: When the leading lady of a small musical revue injures herself, the assistant stage manager must step in to understudy and perform, finding herself thrust into the world and pressures of the show.

films.descriptionZh: 故事在小镇与越战残酷之间拉扯，展现生活与战争对人的摧残与影响。
films.descriptionEn: The film balances an intimate study of small-town American life with the brutality and horror of the Vietnam War, following characters whose lives are profoundly altered by the conflict and its aftermath.

films.canonicalTitle: The Downtown Fest: The Mayflower + Q&A
films.displayTitle: The Downtown Fest: The Mayflower + Q&A
films.descriptionZh: 在心脏病预警下，他以影像追寻家族秘密與存在的意义。
films.descriptionEn: Facing a heart diagnosis, actor-director Nick Sandow embarks on a hybrid documentary-narrative quest to investigate family secrets, confront mortality, and search for identity and the memory of his late father.

films.canonicalTitle: The Downtown Festival: ART/New York & 3 Downtown Artists + Q&A
films.displayTitle: The Downtown Festival: ART/New York & 3 Downtown Artists + Q&A
films.descriptionZh: 三位下城艺术家在影像与访谈中被追述，展现影响城市文化的创作与生活。
films.descriptionEn: Rare archival portraits, interviews, and exhibition footage trace the work and lives of three downtown artists—Mapplethorpe, Basquiat, and Goldin—documenting pivotal moments that shaped New York’s visual culture and alternative scenes.

films.canonicalTitle: The Downtown Festival: Beyond the Threshold - Selection of Short Films
films.displayTitle: The Downtown Festival: Beyond the Threshold - Selection of Short Films
films.descriptionZh: 九部新作短片联展，呈现多样前卫的当代电影切片与声音。
films.descriptionEn: A program of nine newly premiered short films ranging from live performance pieces to narrative and experimental works, presenting a cutting-edge cross-section of contemporary short-form cinema by diverse filmmakers.

films.canonicalTitle: The Downtown Festival: Big Break + Q&A
films.displayTitle: The Downtown Festival: Big Break + Q&A

films.canonicalTitle: The Downtown Festival: Dwarf Neon Mayfield + Q&A
films.displayTitle: The Downtown Festival: Dwarf Neon Mayfield + Q&A
films.descriptionZh: 镜头随风暴扫过肯塔基乡间，记录残存生活与崩解的亲密图景。

films.canonicalTitle: The Downtown Festival: L.I.E (25th Anniversary Screening) + Q&A
films.displayTitle: The Downtown Festival: L.I.E (25th Anniversary Screening) + Q&A
films.descriptionZh: 一名少年在失去与被遗弃后滑入边缘世界，与一位危险的前海军建立复杂关系。
films.descriptionEn: After his mother’s death and his father’s abandonment, a grieving fifteen-year-old descends into suburban delinquency and forms an unlikely, dangerous friendship with an older ex-Marine, exploring grief, vulnerability, and predation.

films.canonicalTitle: The Downtown Festival: Let Them Be Seen + Q&A
films.displayTitle: The Downtown Festival: Let Them Be Seen + Q&A

films.canonicalTitle: The Downtown Festival: Music Videos Are Cinema Too
films.displayTitle: The Downtown Festival: Music Videos Are Cinema Too

films.canonicalTitle: The Downtown Festival: Sitting Ducks + Q&A
films.displayTitle: The Downtown Festival: Sitting Ducks + Q&A
films.descriptionZh: 两位小偷结成荒诞搭档，带着赃款踏上追梦与逃亡的疯狂旅程。
films.descriptionEn: Two small-time thieves form a bizarre comic duo who, with a limousine full of mob cash, flee toward Miami and a hoped-for refuge in Costa Rica; their misadventures mix caper energy with dreamlike pursuit of escape.

films.canonicalTitle: The Downtown Festival: Slauson Rec + Q&A
films.displayTitle: The Downtown Festival: Slauson Rec + Q&A
films.descriptionZh: 纪录一处实验戏剧工坊中，师徒关系如何在创作中滑向操控。

films.canonicalTitle: The Downtown Festival: The Basics of Philosophy + Q&A
films.displayTitle: The Downtown Festival: The Basics of Philosophy + Q&A
films.descriptionZh: 一位哲学教授被往事与良知逼问，生活与责任的边界逐渐崩裂。
films.descriptionEn: John Jorissen, a philosophy professor writing on Spinoza at a small Midwestern college, faces a resurfacing figure from his past after his father’s death, forcing him to confront guilt, obligation, and the fragile life he has constructed.

films.canonicalTitle: The Downtown Festival: The Joyless Economy + Q&A
films.displayTitle: The Downtown Festival: The Joyless Economy + Q&A
films.descriptionZh: 她以电影藏品为线索，借第二人称催眠式旁白吐露出婚外情与自白。

films.canonicalTitle: The Downtown Festival: Two Neighbors + Q&A
films.displayTitle: The Downtown Festival: Two Neighbors + Q&A
films.descriptionZh: 两个性格迥异的女子在豪宅派对后交织出嫉妒、欲望與意想不到的魔力影响。
基于童年回忆的魔幻现实史诗，河畔岁月交错。
films.descriptionEn: A magic-realist epic drawn from memories of childhood on the Desna River that moves between pre-revolutionary idylls, World War II horrors, and contemporary scenes, weaving intimate recollection into ravishing, poetic spectacle.

films.descriptionZh: 王权与私情交织，暗潮涌动中权力与野心博弈上演。
films.descriptionEn: In early 18th-century England, a frail Queen relies on her friend Lady Sarah to govern; when Abigail arrives as a servant, she climbs into the queen’s favor and exploits political distractions to pursue her own ambitious return to status.

films.descriptionZh: 温顺职员化身舞台反派，靠耍诈角力找回自我。
在偏僻庄园，两位女性与一桩诈骗阴谋之间展开欲望与欺骗的角力。
纪录片以混合幽默與情感的方式，追索混凝土作为纽约基石的故事与意义。
脱离电视秀后，导演探索以贺卡片式公式来纪录混凝土与日常美学的可能性。
films.descriptionEn: After ending his TV show, a filmmaker attends a workshop on writing Hallmark movies and then tries to apply that formula to a documentary about concrete, searching for a new creative outlet and approach.

films.descriptionZh: 以普罗米修斯为蓝本的先锋影像，交织神话与创作激情。
一位波兰女移民在充满诱惑与陷阱的纽约拼命自救与互助。
偏远苏格兰岛上，兄妹捕猎海鸟并讲述祖辈故事。
films.descriptionEn: On a remote Scottish isle, siblings Isla and Sandy spend their days hunting seabirds and retelling the stories of their ancestors, living a rugged, insular life shaped by family lore.

films.descriptionZh: 一位女牌手在大西洋客轮上欺骗并意外坠入爱河，随后设法挽回真情。

films.canonicalTitle: The Lair of the White Worm
films.displayTitle: The Lair of the White Worm
films.descriptionZh: 考古学家发现奇怪头骨后，邻镇居民接连失踪，怪事频仍。
films.descriptionEn: After an archaeologist uncovers a strange skull in a distant land, residents of a nearby town begin to vanish and a series of inexplicable occurrences follows, plunging the community into mounting dread.

films.descriptionZh: 聚焦极限登山行业与文化变迁，通过一趟2021年远征层层剖析。
films.descriptionEn: A probing look at the industry and evolving culture of extreme mountain climbing that focuses on a 2021 expedition to unpack complex, harrowing, and moving dimensions of the sport.

films.canonicalTitle: The Last First: Winter K2 (Open Captioning)
films.displayTitle: The Last First: Winter K2 (Open Captioning)

films.descriptionZh: 以轻快笔触改写安徒生，揭示小美人鱼的孤独與渴望。
films.descriptionEn: A sprightly take on Hans Christian Andersen’s tale, the film balances a hot crustacean band and a keening sense of angst and longing embodied in Ariel’s dream of being “Part of Your World,” supported by Menken and Ashman’s celebrated songs.

films.descriptionZh: 柴可夫斯基为压抑同性倾向而结婚，却娶了放荡的妮娜，婚姻难以圆满。
films.descriptionEn: Composer and conductor Peter Ilych Tchaikovsky struggles with his homosexual tendencies and attempts to suppress them by marrying Nina, a volatile nymphomaniac whose desires he cannot satisfy.

films.descriptionZh: 一位古籍鑑定者為一本罕見古書遠赴歐洲，卻捲入邪教與神秘事件。
联邦新探克拉丽斯为捉拿连环杀手向囚犯汉尼拔求解。
自由奔放的温蒂在与年长离异的杰克的关系中陷入抉择，旧爱回归让局势复杂化。
films.descriptionEn: Free-spirited Wendy finds herself at a crossroads in her relationship with an older divorced father, forcing both of them to confront change and where they go from here.

films.canonicalTitle: The Taking of Pelham One Two Three
films.displayTitle: The Taking of Pelham One Two Three
films.descriptionZh: 一列被劫持的地鐵使一名運輸警官獲得出人意表的英雄機會；放映當天有導讀與簽書會。
在肮脏的洛杉矶，机械杀手追踪一位未来救主的母亲。
一名工程師失蹤後，後核烏lysses展開尋找新能量物質的荒誕航程。
男子为失踪女友展开三年执着追寻，终与绑匪正面交锋。
五位丽兹本姐妹在郊区中如幻影般漂浮，她们与男孩们的欲望引发改变人生的连锁事件。
films.descriptionEn: In a sleepy Michigan suburb, five Lisbon sisters become objects of neighborhood boys’ longing; their isolation and delicate beauty lead to a chain of events—sparked by a prom—that reshapes the boys’ lives forever.

films.descriptionZh: 乡村警长调查连环命案，村民怀疑一名日本流浪者是恶灵，故事充满巫术、逐魂与基督象征。
纽约帮派被诬陷后横穿全城返乡的夜行冒险。
一位台湾裔男子为讨父母欢心安排假婚礼，却被父母坚持办起盛大婚宴，文化冲突与情感纠葛交织。
一位准父亲为糊口加入保镖行列，却卷入跨国犯罪與刺杀阴谋，动作爆裂。
一週匆忙拍攝中，樂手在東京的工作與日常被拼貼成影像拼圖。
童年创伤让男孩成了聋哑盲的弹球天才与教派偶像。
films.descriptionEn: After traumatic events in his childhood leave him psychosomatically deaf, dumb, and blind, a boy rises to become a master pinball player and ultimately the focus of a fervent religious cult.

films.canonicalTitle: Trains, Children & Dreams: A Shorts Program
films.displayTitle: Trains, Children & Dreams: A Shorts Program
films.descriptionZh: 一组短片以火车为线索，勾连儿童与梦境中的影像记忆。
一位归来的希腊裔电影人穿越巴尔干，寻觅三卷珍贵底片，影像中充满战争、帝国衰落與哀伤。
一位外星女性以人为食，却逐渐体会人性。
films.descriptionEn: An alien who takes human form preys on men but begins to find something like humanity within herself, rendered through moody cinematography, improvised dialogue, and an unnerving atonal score.

films.descriptionZh: 由多位导演组成的恐怖选集，夹杂原创音乐短片与木偶段落。
films.descriptionEn: An anthology of new horror segments and original music-video interludes assembled from directors including Ernest Dickerson, RZA, David Moreau, and Renee Zhan, the latter featuring original puppets by Jim Henson’s Creature Shop.

films.descriptionZh: 一组以女性身体为中心、对抗男权艺术的短片，包含对表演、断裂肢体与性欲的激进探讨。
伪纪实手法剖析一名妓女的艰难人生。
films.descriptionEn: This searing melodrama uses a pseudo-documentary style to investigate the daily hardships and personal consequences faced by a woman working as a prostitute.

films.descriptionZh: 一位天使在柏林厌倦旁观人世，因爱上凡人而渴望体验肉身生活。
films.descriptionEn: In Berlin, an angel weary of an ethereal existence observes humanity until he falls for a mortal trapeze artist and begins to long for the tangible joys and pains of human life, prompting a desire to become fully alive.

films.descriptionZh: 两位姐妹在二十年代英矿镇中探索欲望与爱情。
films.descriptionEn: Set in a sheltered 1920s English coal-mining community, two free-spirited sisters explore erotic love with a wealthy playboy and a thoughtful educator, with passionate consequences that reshape all their lives.

films.descriptionZh: 觀察台北中產三代情感生活的溫柔長片。
films.descriptionEn: A gentle, restrained study of three generations in an upper‑middle‑class Taipei family, shifting between comic foibles and a pervasive melancholy to explore missed opportunities and the hidden emotional spaces of everyday life.

films.descriptionZh: 旧金山市民被连环杀手“黄道带”恐吓，追凶成痴。
